text.card: A red giant 3,104 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.86 solar masses and 7.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,628 K at its surface.
